title: Logical asset role mapping
description: Maps logical asset roles (the only asset names story/engine code may use) to concrete art. The LOCAL file (config/asset-roles.local.json, gitignored) may reference private-library files via cache copies; the committed example must not contain private paths. Role grammar: <layer>.<subject>.<qualifier...> e.g. bg.cointoss.pit.wide.night, char.merdou.laugh, npc.joro.afraid, vfx.impact.white, ui.choice.frame.

src.description: Runtime URL relative to play/ (cache copy in private mode; committed fallback otherwise)

crop.description: x,y,w,h in source pixels applied at build time

temp.description: TEMP_VISUAL_MODEL or below-threshold candidate explicitly marked temporary
